notes:
Account background: mid-market SaaS (multi-tenant analytics product). Primary driver: lower inference TCO + predictable latency for in-app assistant and search. Currently on provider X (API-first). Interested in migrating in two phases: Hosted API for fast go-live, then Dedicated (VPC) for predictable capacity and compliance.

Technical constraints / asks:
- Throughput target: 80-150 QPS for embeddings + 120 QPS chat peak; p95 chat latency target ~150ms for short queries (<=128 tokens)
- Cost sensitivity: wants ~20-30% decrease in per-token cost vs current provider (TCO model attached)
- Model parity requirement: must match current prompt outputs within tolerance (business logic depends on phrasing) — will run automatic parity harness + human pass
- Fallbacks/routing: prefer automatic fallback to smaller model during bursts; ask about prompt-preserving fallbacks
- Security: SSO/SAML, SOC2 attestation required, KMS for key separation, audit logs + retention controls, EU residency for a subset of data

POC scope and acceptance criteria:
- Phase 1 (Hosted POC, 2 weeks): integrate using Redwood Hosted OpenAPI-compatible endpoint, run 20k prompt evals (chat + summarization + rerank), measure regressions, latency, cost. Acceptance: regressions <=2% (high severity), p95 latency <=200ms, cost <= threshold in TCO spreadsheet.
- Phase 2 (Dedicated): rack-level SLA, autoscaling policy, dedicated KV cache options, quantization profile tests; pilot for 4 weeks.

Migration specifics discussed on calls:
- Compatibility shim: customer wants minimal code changes. SE showed Redwood's compatibility endpoint + request param mapping (temperature, top_p, stop tokens). Need explicit mapping doc for edge params (logprobs, echo).
- Tokenization differences noted: Redwood tokenization for model Y leads to ~8% token count delta on long docs — finance wants run-rate estimate.
- Prompt parity results: initial 10k-run: summarization regressions concentrated in prompts with multi-step instructions; reranking parity was good (95% stable), embeddings cosine similarity >0.98 for 80% of vectors.
- Regressions: example categories: (1) tone shift (shorter summaries), (2) missing list items in bullet extraction, (3) slightly different handling of code fences. SE logged two repros (Jira LLM-1287, LLM-1310).

Commercial / procurement notes:
- Customer prefers annual committed capacity for Dedicated but needs price anchors from Hosted POC first. Procurement expects legal review (standard SaaS + security addendum).
- Finance prefers consumption-first pilot then commit if P95 latency and cost targets met.

Stated quotes from stakeholders:
- "If we can get parity on our summarization prompts and shave costs by ~25%, we'll move to Dedicated." — Head of Product
- "Minimize dev churn — we need an adapter we can drop in, not a rewrite." — Lead Engineer

Next actions (short):
- AE to share parity harness template + runbook (by 2026-03-12)
- SE to deliver mapping doc for OpenAI params -> Redwood compat (by 2026-03-15)
- Kick off Hosted POC with 2 sample datasets and 10k prompts each (start 2026-03-17)
- Security to provide SOC2 + KMS design note; update Drive security doc (link above)
